title.text: Yummy Treats! - eight homepage directions (same shop, same products, same copy, laid out eight ways)

n1.text: 1 Shelf (the safe, conventional shop). White, black type, one red signal; Plus Jakarta Sans, Thai: Noto Sans Thai. Search-first header, split hero, category tiles, a 4-up grid with pack-size chips and price per kg. Dog / Cat toggle and Add to cart work in Play. Best for: a client who wants a shop that looks like a shop. Pick this if: you want the fastest build and the closest 1:1 map to WooCommerce blocks. Refs: Open Farm, Scrumbles, Lily's Kitchen. Matches the portfolio's unused Showroom direction.

n2.text: 2 Pantry (warm and local). Paper, olive and brick; Lora display with Nunito body, Thai: Noto Serif Thai + Anuphan. Illustrated hero, products on shelves by category, recipe-card guides, a stockist map. Add to basket fills a free-delivery bar in Play. Best for: own-brand trust, the kitchen story, care guides. Pick this if: the brand voice is friendly and homemade. Refs: Forthglade, Bocce's Bakery, Lily's Kitchen.

n3.text: 3 Lab (transparent and precise). Cool white, cobalt accent; IBM Plex Sans + Plex Mono labels, Thai: IBM Plex Sans Thai. The analysis table IS the hero, a feeding calculator (move the weight in Play), a comparison table with [STAT] placeholders, dense product rows. Best for: ingredient and feeding transparency, premium-health buyers. Pick this if: you want to prove the brand with numbers rather than mood. Refs: Sundays for Dogs, Butternut Box, Maev.

n4.text: 4 Billboard (the bold one). CHOSEN 30 Oct 2026, see the Billboard page, where the palette was softened to mustard, raspberry and blue. This board keeps the original neon yellow, hot pink and cobalt; hard shadows; Bricolage Grotesque + Space Grotesk, Thai: Prompt. Oversized name as the hero, product pills, sticker badges, one scrolling offer bar with a Pause button. Add to cart bounces the cart in Play. Best for: treats, seasonal drops, a brand with the name Yummy Treats!. Refs: Drink Mockly, Magic Spoon, Edgard & Cooper.

n5.text: 5 Noir (dark and premium). Near-black, warm ivory text, amber accent; Cormorant Garamond + Manrope, Thai: Noto Serif Thai + Anuphan. Full-bleed hero where the pack flips to its back label (R2) in Play, a horizontal product strip, vet-clinic stockists. Best for: a premium cat line, proving a dark theme.json variation. Pick this if: the brand should feel expensive. Refs: Lambwolf, Liquid Death (restraint, not the metal), Jinx. Kept for a future demo.

n6.text: 6 Studio (quiet gallery). White and one pale grey, no accent; Manrope light and regular, Thai: Anuphan. One centred column, large product images, tiny type, accessories first. The Larger / Smaller toggle re-flows the grid in Play. Best for: accessories, photograph-led products. Pick this if: the products will have good photography and the range stays small. Refs: WAKA-WAKA, Brightland, Tuft + Paw. Kept for a future demo.

n7.text: 7 Kit (bundle-first bento). Off-white, emerald accent with mint and coral tints; Outfit + DM Sans, Thai: Noto Sans Thai. A five-cell bento hero (new dog kit, new cat kit, treats, bowls, guides), a kit builder (pick three items, the saving updates in Play), comparison tiles. Best for: new owners, starter sets, a shop that wants a higher basket. Pick this if: bundles are the business model. Refs: Wild One, Fable sets, Lambwolf tiers. Kept for a future demo.

n8.text: 8 Ledger (type-led, international). Light grey ground, black type, one orange accent; Archivo + JetBrains Mono, Thai: Bai Jamjuree. A four-line TL;DR instead of a hero, horizontal product rails with arrows (Play) and a life-stage filter, mono facts grid, stockists as a table. Minimal photography. Best for: a polished international look on a photo budget. Pick this if: the brand wants to feel like a design studio. Refs: Daylight, Oatly, WAKA-WAKA.

b-t0.text: Billboard · 1 Foundations: palette, type, components, sitemap and build map

b-n0.text: Style guide: Mustard #E9C46A ground, Ink #1A1A2E, Raspberry #B8325A, Blue #3A55C4, White, Muted #4A4A66. Every text pair passes AA (ink on mustard 10.2:1, white on raspberry 5.8:1, white on blue 6.4:1, muted on mustard 5.1:1); pink and cobalt are fills, never small text on yellow (3.5:1 and 3.8:1). Type: Bricolage Grotesque 800 display, Space Grotesk body; Thai: Prompt for both, headings 20% smaller with more line height. Pill buttons, 3 px borders, hard shadows 4/6/8 px, 20 px card corners. All states drawn.

b-n1.text: theme.json mapping: the palette and the fluid type scale become settings.color.palette and typography.fontSizes; Prompt and Bricolage are self-hosted fontFace entries (Thai subset separate). Shadows and borders live in custom properties. Dark mode: none, Billboard is a one-theme site.

b-n2.text: Sitemap and build map: 11 templates, which WooCommerce block template each one overrides, which pieces are patterns (sections) and which are template parts (header, footer, mini cart). The three journeys: buy, find a stockist, ask on LINE.

b-n3.text: Placeholder content: prices, delivery rates, feed registration, vet name, stockists, addresses and every statistic are in [brackets] or are sample values to show the layout. Reviews are shown in their empty state on purpose. Nothing here is a real claim until a source is attached.

b-t1.text: Billboard · 2 Shop flow: home → shop → product → cart → checkout → order received (click through in Play)

b-n10.text: Home: the chosen direction, now linked. Marquee with Pause (WCAG 2.2.2), Dogs / Cats blocks, Loud favourites with Add to cart, Read the bag, guides, stockists, LINE. Every product card links to the Product board, the cart button to Cart, nav to Shop. Static hero, no carousel (Baymard, Apr 2025).

b-n11.text: Shop: one list for everything, WooCommerce Product Collection + Product Filters. Chips for pet, category, life stage, availability and a price band; counts on every value, applied chips with x and Clear all, four sorts, no pagination for 24 SKUs (R8, R10, R11). Try the chips in Play. Price per kg on every card (R3), one badge max.

b-n12.text: Product: gallery with the label slide (R2), weight buttons with stock per option and price per kg (R3, R4), three lines under the button: delivery date, cost or threshold, returns (Baymard). Quantity stepper, Add to cart and Notify me work in Play. HTML tables for ingredients, analysis and feeding; reviews block in its empty state; LINE and marketplace buttons; related products.

b-n13.text: Cart: change quantities or remove (Play), the pre-order item carries its ship date as a line, free-delivery bar, the total including delivery before checkout (Baymard: extra costs are the top abandonment reason). Guest checkout is the only button.

b-n14.text: Checkout: one page, Thai address in local order (postcode first, then province, district, subdistrict), payment as a radio list with PromptPay first; the Pay button renames itself per method (R14). Pick a method in Play. Slip upload happens after the order, not here. PDPA consent line. Billing never re-asked (WCAG 3.3.7).

b-n15.text: Order received: the awaiting-payment state, because on Playground PromptPay is marked paid by hand. QR with countdown, bank details and slip upload on this page, what happens next as steps, delivery date, the guide for the food bought, and save-your-details last (R16). Switch the state in Play.

b-t2.text: Billboard · 3 Service: help & contact, stockists, a guide, search, account, states

b-n20.text: Help and contact: one page with anchors (#delivery, #payment, #returns, #faq, #message). LINE first, then phone and email. Delivery table by zone, four payment methods with the slip step explained, returns, FAQ accordion (Play), a short form with PDPA consent.

b-n21.text: Stockists: province and district filter (Play), pet shops and vet clinics, map placeholder, a call-to-action for shops that want to stock the range. Moochie-style list, JerHigh-style channel logos as text buttons.

b-n22.text: Guide article: the switching guide with a seven-day table, product cards inline, and the vet credit. Plain WordPress single post template; the three guides are the only content the shop publishes.

b-n23.text: Search: type in Play. Synonyms map to the shop's names (kibble, dry, อาหารเม็ด → dry food). Results as product cards plus guides. Empty result shows categories and LINE.

b-n24.text: Account: WooCommerce My Account with the slip status per order, buy again, addresses, LINE updates. Nothing beyond what WooCommerce gives by default, restyled.

b-n25.text: States: empty cart, no results, 404, sold out with Notify me (the buy button never disappears, R6), expired PromptPay QR, form errors, loading skeleton. Each gives one next step.

b-n30.text: Phone: headings about 48/36/28 px, Thai 20% smaller. Two-column grid, swipeable rows, 44 px targets, filter bottom sheet with Show N results (Play), sticky Add to cart bar on product with the price, a checkout with a collapsible summary and numeric keyboards. Stickers scale down, shadows go to 3 px.

b-n31.text: Everything that moves on its own has a Pause button and a static fallback under prefers-reduced-motion. Product tiles and swatch rows are swipeable and also have arrows (WCAG 2.5.7).
